summary: Go SDK metric and telemetry names: how they move to the names of the reference

options.description: Reference names only in one 0.x release; Go-only names removed; release note with an old-to-new table
Emit both old and new names for a deprecation period
Keep the Go-only names as a superset of the reference
Keep the Go names and exempt them from parity

body: Problem: the Go SDK defines metric and telemetry names that differ from the reference, and some that the reference lacks. Renaming breaks dashboards and queries built on the Go names. Ruling: reference names only in one 0.x release; Go-only names are removed; the release note carries an old-to-new table.
